# Decouple Runner from Concrete UI Types

## Context

`runner/workflow.rs` directly imports and uses `BivvyTheme` and `live_output_callback` from the UI layer, and `SpinnerHandle::progress_bar()` leaks `indicatif::ProgressBar` into the trait signature. This means the runner knows about concrete terminal types instead of working purely through the `UserInterface` and `SpinnerHandle` traits.

## Changes

### 1. Replace `progress_bar()` with `create_output_callback()` on `SpinnerHandle`

**File: `src/ui/mod.rs`**
- Remove `use indicatif::ProgressBar;`
- Remove `fn progress_bar(&self) -> Option<ProgressBar>` from `SpinnerHandle`
- Add with default returning `None`:
  ```rust
  fn create_output_callback(&self, base_message: String, indent: usize, output_mode: OutputMode) -> Option<crate::shell::OutputCallback> { None }
  ```

**File: `src/ui/spinner.rs`**
- Implement `create_output_callback` on `ProgressSpinner` — calls `live_output_callback(self.bar.clone(), ...)` internally, derives `max_lines` from output_mode (Verbose→3, Normal→2, else→None)
- Remove `progress_bar()` from `SpinnerHandle for ProgressSpinner`
- Update test `progress_bar_returns_clone` → test `create_output_callback`

**File: `src/ui/non_interactive.rs`**
- Implement `create_output_callback` on `NoopSpinner` — returns a `println!` callback when `output_mode == Verbose` (moves logic from workflow.rs lines 617-633)
- Add needed imports (`OutputLine`, `OutputMode`)

### 2. Add formatting methods to `UserInterface` trait

**File: `src/ui/mod.rs`** — add with plain defaults:
```rust
fn format_step_header(&self, index: usize, total: usize, name: &str, title: &str) -> String;
fn format_skipped(&self, msg: &str) -> String;       // "○ msg" (all dim)
fn format_status_line(&self, status: StatusKind, msg: &str) -> String;  // "icon msg"
```

**File: `src/ui/terminal.rs`** — themed overrides:
- `format_step_header` → uses `self.theme.step_number`, `self.theme.step_title`, `self.theme.dim`
- `format_skipped` → uses `self.theme.format_skipped(msg)`
- `format_status_line` → uses `status.format(&self.theme, msg)`

`NonInteractiveUI` and `MockUI` use the plain defaults — no changes needed.

### 3. Refactor `runner/workflow.rs`

- Remove imports: `crate::ui::spinner::live_output_callback`, `crate::ui::theme::BivvyTheme`
- Remove `let theme = BivvyTheme::new();`
- Replace `theme.format_skipped(...)` → `ui.format_skipped(...)`
- Replace step_display formatting block → `ui.format_step_header(index, total, step_name, &step.title)`
- Replace `StatusKind::*.format(&theme, ...)` → `ui.format_status_line(status, ...)`
- Replace 30-line output callback section → `spinner.create_output_callback(attempt_label.clone(), 6, output_mode)`

## Files Modified

1. `src/ui/mod.rs` — trait changes
2. `src/ui/spinner.rs` — ProgressSpinner: new method, remove old
3. `src/ui/non_interactive.rs` — NoopSpinner: verbose callback
4. `src/ui/terminal.rs` — themed formatting overrides
5. `src/runner/workflow.rs` — remove all direct UI type usage

## Verification

1. `cargo test --all-features` — all existing tests pass
2. `cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings` — no warnings
3. Verify `runner/workflow.rs` no longer imports `BivvyTheme`, `live_output_callback`, or `ProgressBar`
